title: Sleep Cycle Calculator
description: Estimate wake-up or bedtime times using 90-minute sleep cycles plus 15 minutes to fall asleep. Times stay on this device.
intro: Pick a bedtime or a wake time and get nearby cycle estimates. This is a planning aid, not medical advice.
blurb: Estimate bed and wake times from 90-minute cycles plus a fall-asleep buffer.
howItWorks: Choose whether you know bedtime or wake time, then enter a 24-hour clock time.
Press Calculate. Each suggestion adds 15 minutes to fall asleep plus 3 to 6 cycles of 90 minutes.
Use the list as an estimate. Individual sleep length varies.
examples: Bedtime 23:00 suggests a 04:45 wake time after four cycles.
Wake time 07:00 suggests a 00:15 bedtime for five cycles.
Six cycles from 22:30 lands at 07:45 the next morning.

faq.a: A commonly cited average adult cycle is about 90 minutes. The tool uses that fixed estimate plus 15 minutes to fall asleep. It is not a measurement of your sleep.
No. It only does clock arithmetic so you can plan a consistent schedule. Talk to a clinician for sleep problems.
No. The suggestions are calculated in the browser.
